concrete_scene.heading: Worked intent contract: “clean up the repo”
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A user, an intent compiler, a protected dirty repository, and downstream planning and authority gates
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Interpret and execute the terse request “clean up the repo.”
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: Read-only inspection is admissible, while deletion, history rewriting, remote publication, and credentialed effects remain unresolved until explicitly contracted.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether a plausible desired outcome permits the system to invent scope, destructive means, authority, or completion evidence; it does not.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: The intent owner retains ambiguity and acceptance criteria; authority, planning, execution, and publication owners retain their independent gates.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The local resolution model checks authored route and transport behavior, not natural-language understanding, complete preference inference, consent, or satisfaction.

worked_trace.heading: Worked intent contract: “clean up the repo”
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The modeled contract can preserve declared fields and route gaps; it does not establish semantic completeness, legitimate consent, user satisfaction, or execution authority.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The naive baseline treats “clean up” as permission to delete and push. The governed path preserves the raw request, admits inspection, and leaves destructive means and remote effects unresolved.
readable_claim: A short request can be operationally incomplete even when its goal sounds obvious; preserving the raw words and the unresolved choices is part of faithful execution.
normative_rule: Compile only the constraints and authority the person actually supplied or explicitly confirmed. Route unresolved scope, destructive effects, publication, spending, credential use, and changes of means to clarification or review; never fill them from convenience.

formal_binding.anchor: versioned interpretation contract that preserves the raw request

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The scene consolidates the parser, preference, consent, and satisfaction boundary in one evidence sentence.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Intent interpretation, planning, authority, consent, effects, training rights, publication, and satisfaction remain independently governed.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: Concrete unanswered questions remain in reader prose; exhaustive contract fields and mutation families remain in the formal surfaces.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The readable claim and rule project the long formal intake contract into two short sentences.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The finite-model boundary is stated once without deleting consent, authority, or semantic-completeness limits.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: The source-role table remains because it distinguishes intent vocabulary from implementation evidence.

non_claims: The scene does not prove natural-language intent understanding.
The modeled route does not infer consent, satisfaction, or hidden authority.
The editorial revision does not move support or release state.
